product_context.concept: A sales app stacked on GoHighLevel: reps run the whole funnel (validated leads, research, decks, transcript-fed proposals, drafted invoices) without ever touching the CRM.

gating_decisions.distribution: internal invite-only (admin provisions reps; Workspace-restricted Google OAuth)
gating_decisions.ai_depth: autonomous pipelines with approval queues + interactive proposal tweak area

core_features: Deck generation (Discovery Call, Follow Up, Strategy Session)

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Single entry: Google sign-in restricted to the company Workspace domain.
screens.rationale: T1 P1: distribution is internal invite-only, so login is the only auth door; no signup, no password flows.
screens.layout: Centered card on the dark shell background: AS shield mark, product name, one Google button, quiet footnote naming the Workspace restriction.

queries: session check redirects authenticated users to /dashboard

states.empty: n/a (static entry screen)
states.error: inline banner: OAuth failure or non-Workspace account, with retry; session-expired arrivals show a 'signed out' banner here (rolled in, not a separate screen)
states.mobile: card centers at full width below 768px

screens.cc_notes: Supabase Auth with hd (hosted domain) restriction server-verified in the callback, never trusted from the client. Pattern: as-vantage-domain-finder auth flow. Middleware guards every (app) route.

screens.name: Auth Callback
screens.purpose: OAuth code exchange handler; verifies Workspace domain and provisioning, then routes.
screens.rationale: T2 P1: handler-only route the login flow passes through; required for OAuth to function at all.
screens.layout: n/a (route handler, never rendered)

queries: profile lookup by auth user id to check provisioning + role

states.empty: n/a

screens.cc_notes: route.ts handler (routes_diff.py expects a handler, not a page). Server-side hd claim check plus profiles row existence: both must pass.

screens.name: Access Denied
screens.purpose: Lands Workspace members who are not provisioned as reps or admins; names the fix.
screens.rationale: T2 P1: invite-only distribution means a valid Google account is not enough; this screen replaces a silent 403 loop.
screens.layout: Centered EmptyState (variant: not-connected): message naming admin provisioning, two actions.

queries: none beyond the failed provisioning check that routed here

states.empty: n/a (the screen is itself a state)

screens.cc_notes: EmptyState variant not-connected per DS rules (empty, filtered, not-connected are different facts). Sign-out runs before the try-different-account redirect.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Rep home: funnel KPIs, what needs attention now, recent activity.
screens.rationale: T1 P1: the post-login landing; the M1 demo starts here.
screens.layout: Sidebar shell; KPI strip (New leads, Suspects awaiting review, Decks this week, Proposals out, Won this month); 'Needs attention' list (suspects, unbooked valid leads, transcripts ready); activity feed rail.

queries: KPI aggregates scoped to the rep (admin: all reps)
needs-attention list (suspect verdicts, valid leads with no booking after N days, transcripts ready without proposals)
latest 20 activity events
realtime: new-lead and verdict events via Supabase Realtime

states.empty: library:empty-state-library: 'No leads yet. New form fills land here automatically.'
states.mobile: KPIs stack 2-up, activity rail drops below 768px

screens.cc_notes: Server component with streamed KPIs. Rep scoping by assigned_to = profile id; admin sees all (role from profiles.role, enforced by RLS not UI). Decks/Proposals tiles render but their list screens are P2: hide those two tiles behind a feature flag until S10/S12 ship (M1 demo shows 3 tiles).

screens.name: Lead List
screens.purpose: Every lead with verdict, stage, age, and next step; the rep's working surface.
screens.rationale: T1 P1: core workflow feature 1; the M1 demo's first stop after intake.
screens.layout: Full-width DataTable: name, company, verdict badge, stage pill, age, assigned rep (admin), last sync indicator; filter bar (verdict, stage, age, archived); suspect banner when the queue is non-empty.

queries: paged leads scoped by role (rep: assigned; admin: all) with latest verdict + stage
suspect count for the banner
jobs: lead ingest from the GHL webhook (Inngest)

modals.name: export-csv
modals.fields: column picker, current-filter scope note

modals.name: archive-lead
modals.fields: lead name echo, reason (optional), type-to-confirm off (soft delete, reversible)

states.empty: library:empty-state-library: 'No leads yet. New form fills land here automatically.'
states.mobile: table collapses to card list below 768px

screens.cc_notes: DataTable with null-sorts-last (age on never-synced leads is null, never 0, per DS data honesty). Archived is a filter on the same route, not a separate screen. The sync indicator is the visible seam from the prototype: hover shows the last write to GHL.

screens.name: Lead Detail
screens.purpose: Everything about one lead: research brief, verdict, decks, proposals, meetings, status timeline, and every GHL write.
screens.rationale: T1 P1: the drill-down for the core list; research + deck generation both run from here in the M1 demo.
screens.layout: Header (name, company, verdict badge, stage pill, assigned rep); tab set: Overview, Research, Decks, Proposals, Meetings, Timeline; right rail: next-step card + sync seam (what was written to GHL, when).

queries: lead with latest research, verdict, decks, proposals, meetings, status history, sync entries
realtime: verdict + transcript-ready events for this lead
jobs: status write-back to GHL on decisions

modals.name: qualification-decision
modals.fields: qualified/disqualified radio, reason, GHL write preview line

modals.name: status-change
modals.fields: status select (full silence-path set), note, GHL write preview line

modals.name: mark-spam
modals.fields: lead echo, spam pattern tag select, 'teaches the classifier' note

modals.name: refresh-research
modals.fields: confirm + cost note (LLM spend)

states.empty: per tab via library:empty-state-library ('No decks yet. Generate the discovery deck.' / 'Research runs automatically after intake.')
states.edit: inline note editing on timeline entries
states.success: toast naming the GHL write that resulted (the seam stays visible)
states.mobile: tabs become an accordion; right rail folds under the header

screens.cc_notes: Every mutating modal shows the exact GHL write it will cause (the prototype's seam principle). Phase gating for M1: the Proposals/Meetings tabs show the library empty state AND the New proposal button, Meeting rows, and Invoice chip stay hidden behind a phase flag until S11/S12/S13 ship their destinations; nothing on this screen may 404 during the M1 demo. Research tab renders lead_research markdown via AIInsightsCard. Deck generation spends LLM tokens: CostPreview in front per DS money rules.

screens.name: Suspect Review Queue
screens.purpose: Human approval queue for 'suspect' verdicts: validate or mark spam, fast.
screens.rationale: T1 P1: the agreed spam design (auto-label obvious, humans judge suspects) requires this queue for the funnel to be trustworthy.
screens.layout: Queue list: lead summary, verdict reasoning excerpt, classifier pattern tags; per-row Validate / Mark Spam actions; keyboard-first (j/k + v/s).

queries: leads with latest verdict = suspect, oldest first, role-scoped
mutations: mark spam (labels + stops funnel + cancels discovery per pipeline rules)
jobs: verdict job writes the queue; spam decision writes back to GHL (cancel booking chase)

modals.name: confirm-validate
modals.fields: lead echo, 'resumes booking sequence in GHL' note

modals.name: mark-spam-queue
modals.fields: lead echo, pattern tag select, 'cancels discovery chase in GHL' note

states.empty: library:empty-state-library: 'Queue clear. Suspects land here when the classifier is unsure.'
states.success: row animates out on decision; toast names the GHL write

screens.cc_notes: This doubles as the D15 agent approval queue. Decisions append to validation_runs as human overrides, which is the classifier's feedback loop. Never dim a row the keyboard still indexes (DS rule).

screens.name: Generate Deck
screens.purpose: One-click deck creation: pick the group (Discovery Call, Follow Up, Strategy Session), review the data going in, generate.
screens.rationale: T1 P1: the M1 demo's centerpiece; template + data per presentation type is a confirmed product decision.
screens.layout: Three template-group cards with preview thumbnails; input review panel (lead fields, research highlights the deck will use); CostPreview; Generate button with progress states.

queries: lead + latest research
active template per group
jobs: Presenton generation job (Inngest): template + lead data + research to HTML, then PDF render

states.empty: n/a (always has the three groups; a missing template renders the group card disabled with 'template not installed')
states.loading: generation progress: queued, composing, rendering, done (RunStatePill)
states.error: generation failure panel with retry + error detail (library:error-state-library styling)
states.success: redirect to deck-detail; first ever deck also fires first-value-celebration

screens.cc_notes: CostPreview required before generation (LLM spend, DS money rule). Template groups are exactly three (operator decision 2026-10-07: Discovery Call, Follow Up, Strategy Session; not SEO decks). Generation is async: the deck row exists immediately, deck-detail shows live progress.

screens.name: Deck Detail
screens.purpose: View, present, share, and export one deck; the booking calendar rides the last slide.
screens.rationale: T1 P1: the deck is the discovery call's artifact; presenting from here is the demo's payoff.
screens.layout: Deck HTML preview (iframe, slide navigation); action bar: Present, Edit, Download PDF, Copy share link, Regenerate; metadata rail (group, lead, generated at, template version, booking-slide status).

queries: deck with render status, share token, template version, lead link

modals.name: share-link
modals.fields: share URL, rotate token action, 'PDF emails after the call' note

modals.name: regenerate-deck
modals.fields: confirm, 'manual edits will be lost unless saved as revision' warning, CostPreview

states.empty: generating state: progress panel until the HTML lands
states.error: render-failed panel with retry and the job error
states.success: toast on share-link copy / PDF ready

screens.cc_notes: Deck HTML is a Presenton artifact served from Supabase Storage behind the share token. Last slide embeds Lee's GHL booking calendar (confirmed working inside the presentation); booking-slide status in the rail shows whether the embed config is set. Present opens the raw HTML full screen in a new window. Phase gating for M1: the Decks breadcrumb targets deck-library (P2); until S10 it renders 'Back to lead' only, so the M1 demo cannot 404 from here. Edit button likewise hidden until S10.

screens.name: Deck Edit
screens.purpose: Edit a generated deck before the call: structured section edits plus prompt-driven regeneration of single slides.
screens.rationale: T2 P2: editable-after-generation is a confirmed Mitchell requirement; the M1 demo can present an unedited deck, so this lands at M2.
screens.layout: Slide list rail; selected-slide editor (headline, body, data fields per template slot); prompt bar ('tighten slide 4', 'swap the case study') that regenerates the selected slide; Save / Discard.

queries: deck slide model (structured slots, not raw HTML)

modals.name: discard-edits
modals.fields: unsaved-changes echo, confirm

modals.name: regen-slide-cost
modals.fields: CostPreview, prompt echo, confirm

states.empty: n/a (always has the generated deck)
states.loading: slide editor skeleton; per-slide spinner on regeneration
states.error: slide regen failure inline with retry
states.edit: the screen is the edit mode; dirty-state guard on exit

screens.cc_notes: Edits work the structured slide model and re-render through Presenton, never hand-edited HTML (keeps PDF parity). Full WYSIWYG is Phase 4 unless Presenton gives it free (open question in project.json).

screens.name: Deck Library
screens.purpose: All decks across leads, filterable by group and status.
screens.rationale: T2 P2: reps reach decks through leads at M1; the cross-lead view earns its place once volume exists.
screens.layout: DataTable: deck name, group badge, lead, generated date, status, share state; filter bar (group, status, date).

queries: paged decks role-scoped with lead join

states.empty: library:empty-state-library: 'No decks yet. Generate one from a lead.'

screens.cc_notes: Pure read surface; creation always starts from a lead (deck-generate needs lead context).

screens.name: Pipeline Board
screens.purpose: Leads by stage, mirroring Lee's GHL pipeline, silence paths included.
screens.rationale: T2 P2: lead-list carries stage at M1; the board view ships with the status engine at M2.
screens.layout: Kanban columns per stage (incoming, discovery booked, discovery held, qualified, proposal review booked, proposal sent, won, lost, nurture); lead cards with age + verdict; stage counts.

queries: leads grouped by current stage, role-scoped
stage definitions + thresholds
mutations: drag = manual status change (same write path as the modal)

modals.name: confirm-stage-move
modals.fields: from/to echo, note, GHL write preview line

states.empty: library:empty-state-library per column: stage-specific one-liners
states.mobile: columns become swipeable; drag disabled, move via modal

screens.cc_notes: Stages mirror GHL and never fork from it: status_defs seeds from the ghl-workstream mapping doc and Lee confirms. Every move writes through the same idempotent GHL write path as lead-detail.

screens.name: Generate Proposal
screens.purpose: Build the Smart Pricing Table proposal from the discovery transcript, deck context, and rep inputs.
screens.rationale: T1 P2: the M2 journey's core (Mitchell flow: discovery ends, review booked 24 to 48h out, transcript + deck context generate the proposal).
screens.layout: Context panel (transcript status + excerpt viewer, deck used, research highlights); extracted-values table (what the transcript set: locations, services, quantities) with per-row accept/override; pricing inputs; CostPreview; Generate.

queries: latest discovery transcript for this lead
deck + research context

states.empty: no-transcript state: 'No transcript matched yet' with manual-paste textarea fallback (the S11 fallback, a first-class state)
states.loading: extraction progress, then SPT creation progress
states.error: extraction/API failure with retry + raw error

screens.cc_notes: Transcript values pre-fill but never auto-commit: the rep sees and can override every extracted value before it hits SPT ('they want 25 locations' becomes an editable row). Manual-paste fallback keeps the funnel alive if Fathom matching fails.

screens.name: Proposal Detail
screens.purpose: Iterate the generated proposal in natural language until right, then send for signature and track it.
screens.rationale: T1 P2: the prompt tweak area is a confirmed Mitchell requirement; signature state drives the invoice flow.
screens.layout: SPT proposal preview (embed/summary of sections + pricing); prompt tweak bar with preset chips ('the website piece needs to be 10,000') and revision history; status rail (draft, sent, viewed, signed); actions.

queries: proposal with SPT state, revisions, signature events, invoice links
mutations: apply prompt tweak (new revision via SPT API)
realtime: SPT webhook events (viewed, signed) surface live

modals.name: tweak-preview
modals.fields: diff of what the tweak changes, CostPreview, apply/cancel

modals.name: send-signature
modals.fields: recipient echo, 'signature triggers invoice drafts' note, confirm

states.empty: generating state until SPT returns the draft
states.error: SPT API failure with retry and raw error
states.edit: the prompt bar is the edit surface; direct edits happen in SPT via the external link
states.success: revision chip animates in; signed state fires confetti-free toast (celebrations stay at first-value)

screens.cc_notes: Tweaks are never silent: the tweak-preview modal shows exactly what changes before it hits SPT. Signature webhook is the S13 trigger; this screen only displays its results. Preset chips seed from admin-templates prompt presets.

screens.name: Proposal List
screens.purpose: All proposals with signature state and value.
screens.rationale: T2 P2: cross-lead proposal tracking for reps and Mitchell once proposals exist.
screens.layout: DataTable: proposal, lead, value, status (draft/sent/viewed/signed), sent date, days out; filter bar.

queries: paged proposals role-scoped with signature state

states.empty: library:empty-state-library: 'No proposals yet. They start from a qualified lead.'

screens.cc_notes: Value column renders null as not-measured (never $0) until SPT returns pricing, per DS data honesty.

screens.name: Invoice Approvals
screens.purpose: Drafted invoice pairs awaiting approval: review the two-invoice logic, approve, send.
screens.rationale: T1 P2: draft-plus-notify is the locked invoicing scope; approval is the one human step in the close.
screens.layout: Queue of invoice pairs: lead/client, one-time amount, recurring amount + start date, signed date, drafted date; per-pair review drawer summary; Approve and send.

queries: pairs with status drafted, joined to proposal + lead
date-logic summary per pair (due now, recurring start)
mutations: approve-and-send (both invoices via Invoice Ninja API)

modals.name: approve-send
modals.fields: both invoice echoes (amounts, due dates, recurring start), confirm

states.empty: library:empty-state-library: 'Nothing waiting. Signed proposals draft their invoices here.'
states.error: library:error-state-library; per-pair draft-failure state with retry
states.edit: n/a (corrections happen in Invoice Ninja; flag-for-correction notes it)
states.success: pair animates out on send; toast with Invoice Ninja links

screens.cc_notes: Admin approves (operator read-only per project.json open question). The date-logic summary renders the rule outcome in words ('signed Nov 1: one-time due now, recurring starts Dec 1') so approval is a judgment, not a calculation.

screens.name: Invoice Pair Detail
screens.purpose: One signed deal's two invoices: line items, date logic, send state, Invoice Ninja links.
screens.rationale: T2 P2: the approval queue needs a drill-down that shows the full date-logic reasoning before money moves.
screens.layout: Two invoice cards (one-time, recurring) with line items and dates; date-logic explanation block; event timeline (signed, drafted, approved, sent); links.

queries: pair with line items, events, proposal + lead join
realtime: send/payment status from Invoice Ninja webhooks

modals.name: approve-send-detail
modals.fields: both invoice echoes, confirm

states.empty: n/a (reached only from an existing pair)
states.error: library:error-state-library; draft-failure state carries the Invoice Ninja API error

screens.cc_notes: Amounts come from the synced Invoice Ninja state, never recomputed locally (one source of truth for money). Operator sees everything read-only: reps track their deal, admins act.

screens.name: Meetings & Recordings
screens.purpose: Fathom recordings matched to meetings and leads; transcript status; rematch when matching errs.
screens.rationale: T2 P2: Fathom matching is the flagged risk; making the match visible and fixable is the mitigation surface.
screens.layout: DataTable: recording, matched meeting + lead (or unmatched badge), duration, transcript status; transcript drawer on row expand; Rematch action.

queries: recordings with match + transcript state
unmatched recordings first
jobs: Fathom sync (Inngest cron): recordings, matching, transcript pull

modals.name: rematch-recording
modals.fields: recording echo, meeting picker (upcoming + recent for the likely lead), confirm

modals.name: transcript-drawer
modals.fields: read-only transcript with speaker turns, copy action

states.empty: library:empty-state-library: 'No recordings yet. Fathom calls land here after they process.'
states.error: library:error-state-library; Fathom API failure banner with last-sync time
states.success: toast on rematch; match badge updates

screens.cc_notes: Matching keys on GHL meeting time + attendee email against Fathom metadata; confidence below threshold renders unmatched rather than guessing (a wrong transcript in a proposal is worse than none). Unmatched-first ordering keeps the risk visible.

screens.name: Notifications Center
screens.purpose: Everything that needs the rep's or approver's attention, in one feed.
screens.rationale: T2 P2: six core event types ship at M2 (valid lead, suspect queued, deck ready, transcript ready, signed, invoice drafted); the 16-alerts decision may widen this.
screens.layout: Feed grouped by day: icon, event line, lead/deal context, age; unread markers; mark-all-read; filter by type.

queries: paged notifications for this profile, unread count
realtime: new notifications push live (the bell badge shares this channel)

states.empty: library:empty-state-library: 'All caught up.'

screens.cc_notes: Row destination depends on event type (lead events to lead-detail, invoice events to invoice-approvals); both are registered affordances. Per-type on/off lives on profile-settings, not here.

screens.name: Profile & Preferences
screens.purpose: Name, avatar, and per-type notification preferences.
screens.rationale: T2 P2: minimal personal surface for an internal tool; Google owns identity, admins own provisioning.
screens.layout: Two cards: profile (name, avatar from Google, role read-only) and notification preferences (per-type toggles).

queries: own profile with notification prefs JSON

modals.name: save-confirm-toast
modals.fields: inline toast only; listed as modal for the affordance contract

states.empty: n/a
states.edit: inline field editing, dirty-state save bar

screens.cc_notes: No password or delete-account flows: Google OAuth only, lifecycle owned by admins on team-reps. Notification prefs gate the fan-out job per type.

screens.name: First-Run Welcome
screens.purpose: Three-step orientation on first login: your leads, the review queue, deck generation.
screens.rationale: T2 P2: onboarding depth is minimal (admin-provisioned internal reps); one screen, not a wizard cluster.
screens.layout: Three-panel stepper with product screenshots: 'Leads arrive validated', 'You judge the suspects', 'One click makes the deck'; Get started.

queries: first_run flag

states.empty: n/a

screens.cc_notes: Routed to from auth-callback when profiles.first_run is true. Skipping also clears the flag (never nag twice).

screens.name: Rep Management
screens.purpose: Provision reps and admins, assign roles, deactivate; one rep at launch, built for 3 to 4.
screens.rationale: T2 P2: the launch rep can be seeded at S4; self-serve provisioning becomes necessary when rep 2 arrives.
screens.layout: Roster DataTable: name, email, role, status, assigned leads count, last active; Provision rep action; row drawer with role + deactivate.

queries: roster with assigned-lead counts

modals.name: provision-rep
modals.fields: Workspace email, role select (rep/admin), 'they sign in with Google' note

modals.name: deactivate-rep
modals.fields: rep echo, lead-reassignment picker (required when leads assigned), confirm

states.empty: n/a (the provisioning admin is always listed)
states.edit: role change inline in the drawer

screens.cc_notes: Provisioning writes the profiles row the auth-callback checks: email must match the Workspace domain. Deactivation blocks until leads are reassigned (no orphaned pipeline).

screens.name: Integrations Health
screens.purpose: Connection status, config, and last-sync health for all six integrations.
screens.rationale: T2 P2: MVP configures via env at S2; the health surface earns its place at GA when non-builders need to see what broke.
screens.layout: Six connection cards (GoHighLevel, Presenton, Smart Pricing Table, Invoice Ninja, Fathom, OpenRouter): status dot, last successful call, error count 24h, Configure + Test actions; OpenRouter card carries spend-today.

queries: connection states with last-success + error counts
LLM spend aggregates

modals.name: configure-connection
modals.fields: non-secret config per provider (location id, calendar id, pipeline map pointer); secrets stay in Vercel env, noted

modals.name: test-result
modals.fields: test call result, latency, raw response excerpt

states.empty: not-connected variant per card before first config
states.error: card-level error state with last error detail
states.success: status dot flips on test pass

screens.cc_notes: Secrets never render or round-trip here: cards show presence ('key set in Vercel env'), not values. EmptyState not-connected variant per DS rules.

screens.name: Deck Templates
screens.purpose: The three template groups: active versions, previews, and the proposal prompt presets.
screens.rationale: T2 P2: templates live in Git (locked decision); this surface shows what is installed and previews it, plus prompt-preset management.
screens.layout: Three group cards (Discovery Call, Follow Up, Strategy Session): active version, updated date, Preview action; prompt-presets card (the proposal tweak chips) with add/edit.

queries: template versions per group
prompt presets
jobs: template sync from repo on deploy

modals.name: template-preview
modals.fields: sample-data render of the template in an iframe

modals.name: confirm-version
modals.fields: version echo, 'new decks only, existing decks unchanged' note

modals.name: edit-preset
modals.fields: preset label, prompt text

states.empty: group card shows 'template not installed' until the repo ships one (placeholders ship at S3)
states.error: preview render failure with the Presenton error

screens.cc_notes: Templates are repo files (Git is the source of truth per the kickoff decision); this screen reads the synced manifest and never edits template content. Mitchell and Zachery's enhanced templates land as repo PRs.

screens.name: Statuses & Thresholds
screens.purpose: The status set mirrored from GHL and the lead-age thresholds that move leads automatically.
screens.rationale: T2 P2: defaults ship in the packet for Lee to confirm; this surface is where they get tuned without a deploy.
screens.layout: Status table (app status, GHL stage mapping, kind: manual/automatic); thresholds card (no booking after N days to nurture, no-show chase days to lost, silent-after-proposal days to lost); audit note of last change.

queries: status defs with GHL mapping
threshold values

modals.name: edit-threshold
modals.fields: threshold echo, new value, 'applies on the next nightly run' note

modals.name: remap-stage
modals.fields: mapping echo, GHL stage picker, 'coordinate with Lee' warning

states.empty: n/a (seeds from the ghl-workstream mapping at S14)

screens.cc_notes: Remapping a GHL stage is the one config that can break the mirror: the warning modal names Lee and the ghl-workstream doc. Threshold defaults: nurture at 14 days unbooked, lost after chase on no-show, lost after 14 days silent post-proposal (Lee confirms).

screens.name: Validation Log
screens.purpose: Every Claude verdict with inputs, reasoning, cost, and human overrides: the AI audit trail.
screens.rationale: T2 P2: autonomous pipelines need an audit surface for trust and classifier tuning; admin-only forensics.
screens.layout: DataTable: timestamp, lead, verdict badge, confidence, pattern tags, human override marker, cost; row drawer with full input/output; spend KPI strip on top.

queries: paged runs with override joins
spend aggregates by day

modals.name: run-drawer
modals.fields: full prompt inputs, verdict reasoning, model, tokens, cost

states.empty: library:empty-state-library: 'No validation runs yet.'

screens.cc_notes: Read-only by design (review agents report, builders fix: same spirit). Overrides come from the suspect queue and are the classifier feedback loop. Cost renders from validation_runs.cost_cents; null while pending, never 0.

screens.name: GHL Sync Log
screens.purpose: Every write the app made to GoHighLevel: the seam, made visible and auditable.
screens.rationale: T2 P2: the prototype's core principle (every click shows what it writes back) needs a forensic surface when something looks wrong in GHL.
screens.layout: DataTable: timestamp, lead, write type (status, stage, field, booking), payload summary, result, retry count; filter by type/result; failure banner when the dead-letter queue is non-empty.

queries: paged writes with result + retries
dead-letter count
jobs: the connector's write path logs here; retry job drains failures

modals.name: retry-write
modals.fields: write echo, idempotency note, confirm

modals.name: payload-drawer
modals.fields: full request/response JSON, redacted auth

states.empty: library:empty-state-library: 'No writes yet. Everything the app tells GHL lands here.'

screens.cc_notes: Built in S6 alongside the connector (the log IS the connector's write path, not an afterthought). Idempotency keys render so duplicate-write debugging is possible. This is the single spam-removal / write-divergence forensic surface the architecture doc asked for.

screens.name: Command Palette
screens.purpose: Cmd-K: jump to any lead, deck, or proposal; run quick actions.
screens.rationale: T2 P2: four data types exceed scannability; the DS CommandPalette covers search, so no search-results page is manufactured.
screens.layout: DS CommandPalette: typeahead across leads/decks/proposals, section-grouped results, quick actions (go to queue, generate deck for...).

queries: typeahead search across the three entity types, role-scoped

states.empty: empty-query state shows recent items; no-results state per DS

screens.cc_notes: DS CommandPalette component as shipped; search endpoint is one RPC across the three tables with RLS doing the scoping. Explicit cut: no global search-results page (internal tool, palette suffices).

screens.name: Empty State Library
screens.purpose: Every primary screen's empty state: one pattern, per-screen copy table.
screens.rationale: T1 P1: new installs live in empty states; the M1 demo opens on several of them.
